The '''''Titan'' 2150 rocket engine''' was a [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] engine produced by [[Vokoff-Strood/Legends|Vokoff-Strood]] prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. [[Ratts Tyerell/Legends|Ratts Tyerell's]] [[Scatalpen (Podracer)/Legends|''Scatalpen'']] used the ''Titan'' 2150 engine during the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] won by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].
